assumptions: Cited, not re-derived, and NOT implemented.
attrs.evidence: P(Γ) is the set of non-empty pp-definable unary relations; by the Inv–Pol Galois connection those are exactly the unary relations preserved by all polymorphisms of Γ, and bounded arity suffices over a finite domain.

source_assumptions: Gamma a finite set of finitary relations

attrs.gap: What IS implemented is a bounded search for a 1PA VIOLATION (conclusive when it hits) and a symmetry certificate (conclusive when it applies). A miss from the bounded search is NOT a proof of 1PA and the code says so. Do not report '1PA holds' on the strength of it.

attrs.statement: 1PA is a decidable property of a finite constraint language.
